typography.heading: Tight tracking, large quiet hierarchy
typography.numbers: Tabular numerals for every input, timer and progress count

designStyle.concept: A premium personal training journal with the clarity of a performance instrument.
designStyle.composition: Flat exercise ledger; asymmetric desktop session rail; mobile bottom navigation.
designStyle.identity: Slash logomark, small numbered exercise indices, green completion ink.
designStyle.imagery: None. Actual performance entries are the visual subject.
designStyle.copy: Natural Turkish; exercise names retained from the original prescription.

visualEffects.approach: Lightweight CSS, no animation framework or ornamental canvas.
visualEffects.reducedMotion: All transitions, animations and smooth scrolling disabled when requested.
